expectations.description: All contract columns exist in the Gold table.
expectations.query: SELECT count(*) FROM (VALUES 'ma_don_vi', 'ten_don_vi', 'ma_lop_hoc_phan', 'nam_hoc', 'hoc_ky', 'ty_le_tien_do_giang_day', 'so_ban_ghi_theo_doi', 'source_record_id', 'source_updated_at', 'source_batch_id', 'source_record_checksum', '_gold_updated_at') AS required(column_name) WHERE column_name NOT IN (SELECT column_name FROM lakehouse.information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'gold' AND table_name = 'teaching_progress_metrics')

expectations.description: Required Gold values have a zero null ratio.
expectations.query: SELECT CAST(count_if(ma_lop_hoc_phan IS NULL OR nam_hoc IS NULL OR hoc_ky IS NULL OR ty_le_tien_do_giang_day IS NULL OR source_record_id IS NULL OR source_record_checksum IS NULL) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(count(*), 0) FROM {data_asset_ref}

expectations.description: Candidate Gold grain has no duplicate groups.
expectations.query: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM {data_asset_ref} GROUP BY ma_lop_hoc_phan, nam_hoc, hoc_ky HAVING count(*) > 1)

expectations.description: Newest source row is no more than 8760 hours old.
